name: Quadratic Scale Hemisphere Sampling
aliases: Halton Hemisphere Sampling with Quadratic Scale
definition: Generates a set of 3D sample vectors for screen-space ambient occlusion (SSAO) using a Halton sequence, mapping them to a hemisphere and applying a quadratic scale distribution.
summary: Quadratic Scale Hemisphere Sampling generates SSAO vectors using a deterministic Halton sequence and quadratic radius bias to concentrate samples near the origin while maintaining uniform angular coverage.
